scope: Prospective training-only native domain calibration and public analytic-function selection; not certified arbitrary-input bounds.
training_split: nyu-mll/glue mrpc train all3668; labels not loaded
input_contract: same pinned model/tokenizer; sequence128; padding=max_length; truncation=True; native float32 eager batch1
inverse_sqrt_method: Retain conditioned power degree<=32; explicitly use balanced Chebyshev from the same already-target-passing serialized polynomial for every other norm. Newton candidatev1 is preserved.
gelu_method: balanced Chebyshev on declared training-derived domain; no monomial conversion execution
softmax_method: fixed degree8 exp[-.5,.5], squarings=ceil(log2(max(abs(domain))/.5)); normalize each square with public K-dependent reciprocal Newton count targeting1e-12 analytic relative error
pooler_method: existing degree candidates8/12/16 tanh[-1,1] with fixed power-of-two domain reduction and rational doubling; public reciprocal domain[1,2.1]
validation_policy: No validation labels or approximate validation outputs used to select domains/degrees/iterations. Freeze candidate bytes first; report every later gate/domain failure without automatic retuning.
limitations: Empirical training ranges with fixed slack are not arbitrary-input guarantees.
Native ranges do not prove approximate or encrypted trajectory coverage.
Native audit at float32; planned approximate reference may use float64 and must compare unchanged original harness gates.
candidate_change: Only unsupported inverse-square-root strategies change; polynomial domains, coefficients and analytic targets are byte-preserved.
